_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

voltage.why: the ACTUAL Turing — Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion, the morphogenesis of his last work; the pattern that decides where the body's spots and stripes go, chemistry writing form before the form exists
the draped, vulnerable body — cloth as skin you walk THROUGH; matter that hangs, yields, and lets you pass, the soft body as the un-armored one
settling, rest, exhaustion — walls that expand and contract; the room itself descends an energy landscape and breathes, soft matter as a body at rest rather than at work

the matter that remembers force — strain-energy heatmap where displacement stays visible; deformation as a record, the body carrying the history of every push (the Turing move: geometry with a biography)
morphogenesis made mineral — the impossibly intricate silica skeleton a single cell grows; soft process, hard result; QFEP form emerging from local rule into an object no designer drew
